text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Wow! You got so many! You're a real
claw
machine pro!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I will! I'll send you a picture after I'm
done setting
them up in my room!
choice_data_list: Please take good care of it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Oh! I thought of a new proverb!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"A plushie a day keeps the running
fatigue at
bay!" I feel like I can work
even harder than ever
with these
plushies by my side!
